method.changedDatasetReview: Every one of 291 v2 accepted/rejected judgments is compared with frozen original source metadata and the first independent report. Every action and destination is independently recomputed from fixed original metadata. All expected groups/tasks and all fixture references are checked.
method.structuralEvidenceReuse: The five v2 HTML fixtures must be byte-identical to original frozen fixtures, whose complete 11,569-control structural/source/replay audit is in the preserved first independent QA report. Exact byte equality permits reuse of already-passed whole-body, full ancestor/sibling chain, table-cell, heading/form role, ARIA-node and CSS visibility checks; those tests are not needlessly rerun.
method.accessibilityNames: Three changed accessible names are independently recaptured in a new headless Chromium context (JavaScript disabled, all network aborted, 1365x1000); all remaining 288 controls retain their unchanged original annotations and first independent accessibility snapshots.
method.searchInputReview: Manually distinguish purpose from arbitrary substring matching. Fixed title/placeholder, parent form, and ancestor context identify each visible editable as search or opinion input. No input value is read.
